facts.fact: ICTD reports the National Bank of Rwanda made eKash, RSwitch's national interoperable payment system, mandatory for off-net payments up to RWF 10 million from July 2026, and monitors and fines providers for downtime.

RWA.note: Document states no consumer protection rules or complaints body.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.
No survey figure on account ownership; 53% is merchants with an informal code.

facts.fact: ICTD says Rwanda's two mobile operators run MTN MoMo and Airtel Money mobile money platforms.
ICTD reports that since July 2026 eKash carries cross-operator payments between MTN and Airtel wallets and bank accounts.

ICTD describes eKash as the national interoperable digital payment and retail system run by RSwitch, connecting commercial banks, microfinance institutions and mobile money operators; BNR reported 28.9 million eKash transactions in September 2026.

RWA.note: Only a planned excise on transaction fees; no electronic tax payment stated.
